current_example.problem:
Calculate the minor of the entry $b_{21}$ in the matrix
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14273095/assets/631c471d5de708ad8c3226886fdaad53878da9c74f063581d70e2837a53533c6.svg)
current_example.worked_solution:
The minor of $b_{21} = 3$ (second row, first column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $3$ are removed: 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14273095/assets/8f0cf1e3a84563c4eccae17aa6bded74589ec4d9fe856a0ee6e4f189445f93b2.svg)

So, the minor of $b_{21}=3$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}det[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 7 & 2\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 7 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot 2-5\cdot 7 \\  & =2-35 \\  & =-33.\end{aligned}
$$
